cmd: F=/opt/trading-bot/tg.env; TK=$(grep '^TG_TOKEN=' $F | cut -d= -f2-); U=$(grep '^TG_USER_ID=' $F | cut -d= -f2-); curl -s -m 20 -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot$TK/setChatMenuButton" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"chat_id\": $U, \"menu_button\": {\"type\": \"commands\"}}"; echo; curl -s -m 20 "https://api.telegram.org/bot$TK/getChatMenuButton?chat_id=$U"; echo
